name: Song Mountain
operator: Intermountain Management (also operates Labrador Mountain; the two are marketed together as SkiCNY)

source.note: Approximate, unsourced estimate west of I-81 between the Preble and Tully exits — confirm on a map.

Summit (approximate, unsourced estimate west of the base; elevation not found)

character: The larger of the two SkiCNY ski areas, set beside I-81 south of Syracuse; it shares an operator and a combined season pass with Labrador Mountain. Its on-site restaurant is Heuga's Alpine.

season.notes: No 2026-27 opening date and no historical opening dates found in research. 2026-27 SkiCNY season passes (valid at Song and Labrador, '2 mountains for 1 price') went on sale in spring 2026; spring pricing ran through Wed Apr 15, 2026 with a Buddy Pass and a $25 voucher for Heuga's Alpine; an 'Early Fall 2026-27' rate page exists. After Toggenburg closed in 2021, reporting described longer lift lines at Song. The operator lost a NY antitrust case in 2025 over buying and closing Toggenburg; remedies were pending as of Aug 2025.
